sessions.prompt:
Add normalize_isbn(s) to catalog.py: a string of exactly 13 digits is returned as it is; anything else raises ValueError. Add tests.

The plan for normalize_isbn has one more step: it also accepts hyphens and spaces between the digits and drops them ("978-0-306-40615-7" becomes "9780306406157"). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): member names are case-insensitive: "Ann" and "ann" are the same member, and a member name is always stored in lower case.

Design decision for this project: a book is due 14 days after the day it is checked out.

tasks.task: normalize_isbn: accept and drop hyphens and spaces

given.handoff: Session 1 added normalize_isbn(s) with tests. Its last step is left for later: accept hyphens and spaces and drop them.
decisions: Member names are case-insensitive and always stored in lower case.
A book is due 14 days after the day it is checked out.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Loans class to loans.py with checkout(isbn, member, day), which records that member borrowed isbn on day (a datetime.date), and holder(isbn), which returns the member who holds isbn, or None. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a member can hold at most 3 books at once; a 4th checkout raises ValueError and records nothing.

Design decision for this project: a late book costs 25 cents for each day it is late.

Design decision for this project: dates in files this project writes are written as DD/MM/YYYY.

given.handoff: Session 2 added Loans.checkout and Loans.holder with tests.
decisions: A member holds at most 3 books; a 4th checkout raises ValueError and records nothing.
A late book costs 25 cents per day late.
Dates in files the project writes are DD/MM/YYYY.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Catalog class to catalog.py with add(isbn, title) and title(isbn), which raises KeyError for an unknown ISBN. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a late book costs 50 cents for each day it is late, not 25.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): checking out a book that is already on loan raises ValueError and leaves the loan unchanged.

Design decision for this project: returning a book that is not on loan does nothing: no error, no change.

given.handoff: Session 3 added the Catalog class with tests.
decisions: Supersedes the 25-cent fine: a late book costs 50 cents per day late.
Checking out a book already on loan raises ValueError and leaves the loan unchanged.
Returning a book that is not on loan does nothing: no error, no change.
